'''Ga'ram''' was the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] assistant to [[Drooga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Ga'ram was charged with managing the feasts and parties on [[Drooga's pleasure barge]] and carrying out Drooga's orders to acquire eccentric forms of entertainment. He interacted with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who would later be known as the [[Voidhound]].<ref name="BM" />
